oi.label: Total Open Interest (OI)
oi.details: Total NIFTY OI: 2,777,058 calls + 3,183,844 puts. High OI = strong institutional interest; OI at OTM puts = support floor, at OTM calls = overhead supply.

chng_oi.label: Change in Open Interest (Chng in OI)
chng_oi.details: Net ΔOI +1,709,934 | long buildup (price ↑, OI ↑). Price ↑ with ΔOI ↑ = long buildup; price ↓ with ΔOI ↑ = short buildup.

highest_call.label: Highest Call Open Interest
highest_call.details: Max call writers at 24,000 = major resistance. resistance building (fresh call writing) (+10,962). Break above with ΔOI<0 = bullish.

highest_put.label: Highest Put Open Interest
highest_put.details: Max put writers at 23,400 = major support. support building (fresh put writing) (+176,140). Break below with ΔOI<0 = bearish.

pcr.label: Put-Call Ratio (PCR)
pcr.details: Total Put OI / Total Call OI = 1.15 — bullish / neutral drift. PCR>1.3 extreme bull (contrarian top), <0.5 extreme bear (contrarian bounce).

atm_pcr.label: Near-the-Money PCR (ATM ±4 strikes)
atm_pcr.details: PCR over ±4 strikes around spot 23,436 = 1.20 — bullish / neutral drift. More current/ATM-sensitive than the full-chain PCR; best pulse of who is defending the money.

iv.label: Implied Volatility (IV)
iv.details: OI-weighted IV 14.64% (ATM 9.39%) | spot 23,436 | expiry 29-Sep-2026 | max pain 23,400. High IV = expensive options / fear; low IV = cheap. Falling IV during a rally = steady accumulation (bullish); IV spikes during a decline = panic put buying (bearish).

bias.label: Option-Chain Bias
bias.details: Weighted composite of OI-positioning signals. Score +75% (strong). | PCR 1.15=bullish · ATM PCR 1.20=bullish · net ΔOI +631,186 · call wall ΔOI +10,962 · put wall ΔOI +176,140 · long buildup (price ↑, OI ↑). Extreme PCR readings are contrarian — fade the crowd.
